method: Agent inspection of actual physical native framebuffer captures; separate from a human novice study and from full stage/publication acceptance

criteria.clarity: Current operation, verified result and failed outcome are distinct; restart instructions identify the installed disk and ISO
criteria.convenience: Normal completion has one primary restart action; failure retains a safe disk-selection or restart route and secondary details
criteria.user_friendliness: No terminal syntax is required; unavailable boot maintenance is absent without the matching live ISO
criteria.appearance: Shared licensed Inter typography, semantic ink, original check/warning silhouettes and consistent panel spacing
criteria.readability: Reviewed compact 800x600 and 1024x768, ordinary, 150% and physical 3840x2160 frames; essential actions and messages are readable without overlap

limits: Agent review does not establish outcomes for actual children or older novice users
Named reference display captures are not universal GPU or physical-display qualification
Boot repair does not promise recovery of arbitrary damaged personal files
